$comment: THE REQUIRED VALIDATION CONTRACT, BY JOB DISPLAY NAME. The publisher reads this file from the CHECKED-OUT SHA it is about to publish and refuses unless every name here appears EXACTLY ONCE in the latest attempt of the CI run at that SHA with conclusion === 'success' (scripts/verify-ci-receipt.cjs). Nothing else on the run is consulted, which is what keeps the deferred heavy simulations reported and non-blocking. This list MUST equal the display names of ci.yml's publish.needs — scripts/check-required-jobs.mjs fails the build if they drift apart. The four jest shard entries are the sharded required surface (scripts/shard-suites.cjs deals live-discovered suites across them by deterministic LPT; check:shardcoverage proves the union equals discovery, exactly once). They are FOUR separate literal display names, never a matrix, so "exactly one job with this name" stays decidable. Adding a required gate means adding it in both places, in the same commit, or the gate refuses.
